situations.title: Scouting / Exploration
situations.visual_rule: Show partial reveal and scout focus; no fake reward.

situations.title: Intel Discovered
situations.visual_rule: Show intel icon / discovered cell; no fake mission text.

situations.title: Resource Opportunity
situations.visual_rule: Show resource icon; reward list only if runtime provides it.

situations.title: Stronghold Located
situations.visual_rule: Show threat marker, not invented enemy stats.

situations.title: Under Attack
situations.visual_rule: Show alert / hostile markers; no fake damage.

situations.title: Extraction Available
situations.visual_rule: No route-line board; show safe area / marker only.

situations.title: Sector Secured
situations.visual_rule: Show secured state only after result payload exists.

situations.title: Return to Strategic Map
situations.visual_rule: Show return/continue state without inventing rewards or consequences.
